comparison.objective: Candidate locks a robot-gripper opening adjustment and verifies it; PR-1951 performs the squeeze-turn-wait-and-withdraw step of a rapid strep test.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires driver/wrench seating and countertorque; PR-1951 maintains a moving squeeze on a soft tube while repeatedly regrasping and turning a swab.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires angular accuracy and low drift over cycles; PR-1951 requires five net turns, a timed dwell, continuously squeezed rotating withdrawal and disposal.
comparison.reason: Maintaining deformable-tube squeeze during swab rotation and withdrawal is not the same ability as locknut-secured stop adjustment; all material rubric details are present.
